data.content:
Lorient are unbeaten in their last four matches against Monaco, winning their last two meetings with them. Monaco have, in fact, only beaten Lorient once in their last six clashes.
 Inconsistency has plagued Lorient this season, as they have two wins, two draws and two losses from their opening six matches. They will be coming into this match on the back of a very good win, though, as they beat current high-flyers Paris FC 1-0 last weekend. [...] Ad

## Lorient vs AS Monaco Prediction

Unbeaten Monaco will come into this match with plenty of confidence thanks to their strong start to the campaign, but they do have a couple of things going against them.

Firstly, they will be less rested than Lorient, as they played in Europe on Thursday. Secondly, top scorer Paris Brunner is suspended. [...] With that said, though, Lorient have been very inconsistent this season, and their lack of goals will be a major concern against a side like Monaco who have been finding ways to win most of their games.

Therefore, the prediction here is an away win.

Prediction: Lorient 1-2 AS Monaco
